task.title: Applying overrides to a running Operator
task.shortdesc: To override container images for a running Red Hat Quay Operator, you can modify the ClusterServiceVersion object to add environment variables that point to your custom images. This applies the overrides at the Operator level, so all QuayRegistry instances use the same custom images.

step.cmd: The ClusterServiceVersion object is Operator Lifecycle Manager’s representation of a running Operator in the cluster. Find the Red Hat Quay Operator’s ClusterServiceVersion by using a Kubernetes UI or the kubectl/oc CLI tool. For example:
